page.layout: One printed page. Running head with page number at the top. Below it, a centred title in two lines. Then a full-width woodcut engraving in a frame. Below the engraving, a verse of eight lines in full width, with a brace-like mark at the left of the first lines. Signature at the foot centre.

l.i: [illegible, ~1 letter]Ernis Et hac medium cingat teres undiq;
Linea, & hinc spatio distet & inde pari? [illegible,
~1 letter]ilicet illa refert quod nos tegit undiq; cælum,
Tellurem hoc punctum quod tenet ima notat. [illegible,
~1 letter]ur igitur doleas? quorsum dic, quaso, labores,
Tu, patria pepulit quem pietatis amor?
Hinc spatio cælum cernis & inde pari.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a circle with a central point and two crossing diameters (a cross inside the circle) over a landscape with rocks, plants and clouds, within a rectangular frame. The first letters of several verse lines are cut off by the binding or the edge of the scan; the reconstructions marked [?] or [illegible] are uncertain. Long s has been written as s and sndiq as undiq.
